name: Temple of Mur
desc: The Temple of Mur is a location in the exclusive Vow of Iron gamemode. It is in the far upper corner of [The Starswept Valley](location:the_starswept_valley), being the place where you fight [Shogun of the Prophet's Guard](entity:shogun_of_the_prophets_guard_temple_of_mur).
additional_info: -   While the Cell room of the Temple does not have a soundtrack as of now, the upper level of the Temple plays In Starstruck Sands by Naktigonis.
